plain: Directly relevant to the matter at hand

webster.text: Related to the subject or matter in hand; just to the purpose; adapted to the end proposed; apposite; not foreign to the thing intended.

example.quote: The honorable gentleman from New York had made many pertinent observations on the propriety of giving stability to the Senate.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, June 23, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
